content.text:
strict-peer-dependencies=false
auto-install-peers=true
engine-strict=true
use-node-version = 24.16.0
prefer-workspace-packages=true

@sw-code:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
===package.json===
{
  "name": "urbo-nx",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "Open Source Smart City App Solution",
  "homepage": "https://swcode.io/",
  "author": "SWCode",
  "scripts": {
    "reset": "pnpx nx reset",
    "build": "pnpm nx run-many -t build --prod",
    "build:all": "pnpm nx run-many -t build --prod",
    "version:stamp": "node tools/generate-version.mts",
    "ci:build": "pnpm run version:stamp && pnpm nx run-many --target=build --all --exclude=app,urboards,cms --parallel=2 && pnpm nx run-many --target=build --projects=app,urboards,cms --parallel=1",
    "ci:build:affected": "pnpm run version:stamp && pnpm nx affected --target=build --prod --parallel=1",
    "assert:nx-targets": "node tools/assert-nx-targets.mts",
    "ci:e2e": "pnpm run assert:nx-targets && pnpm nx affected --target=e2e",
    "e2e": "pnpm nx e2e app-e2e",
    "e2e:ui": "pnpm nx e2e app-e2e -- --project=ui --pass-with-no-tests",
    "ci:format": "pnpm nx format:check",
    "ci:lint": "pnpm run assert:nx-targets && pnpm nx affected -t oxlint lint",
    "ci:test": "pnpm run assert:nx-targets && pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx affected --target=test --coverage --nxBail",
    "typecheck-tests": "pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/app-e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "format": "pnpm nx format:write --all",
    "format:check": "pnpm nx format:check --all",
    "generate:api": "nx run-many -t generate-backend-api,generate-search-api,generate-file-api,generate-legal-api,generate-nina-api,generate-feed-configuration-api,generate-push-api,generate-special-event-mini-api,generate-history-api,generate-iframe-cards-api,generate-weather-api,generate-public-transport-api,generate-participation-api,generate-survey-api,generate-bayern-mobility-api,generate-cms-auth-api,generate-cms-notification-api,generate-cms-queue-api,generate-cms-stele-search-api,generate-cms-stele-api --parallel=1",
    "generate:public-transport-api": "nx run-many -t generate-public-transport-api",
    "generate:participation-api": "nx run-many -t generate-participation-api",
    "generate:survey-api": "nx run-many -t generate-survey-api",
    "generate:push-api": "nx run-many -t generate-push-api",
    "generate:special-event-mini-api": "nx run-many -t generate-special-event-mini-api",
    "generate:history-api": "nx run-many -t generate-history-api",
    "generate:iframe-cards-api": "nx run-many -t generate-iframe-cards-api",
    "generate:backend-api": "nx run-many -t generate-backend-api",
    "generate:file-api": "nx run-many -t generate-file-api",
    "generate:search-api": "nx run-many -t generate-search-api",
    "generate:legal-api": "nx run-many -t generate-legal-api",
    "generate:nina-api": "nx run-many -t generate-nina-api",
    "generate:feed-configuration-api": "nx run-many -t generate-feed-configuration-api",
    "generate:weather-api": "nx run-many -t generate-weather-api",
    "generate:bayern-mobility-api": "nx run-many -t generate-bayern-mobility-api",
    "generate:map-glyphs": "nx run-many -t generate-map-glyphs",
    "lint": "pnpm nx affected -t oxlint lint",
    "prepare": "pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run generate:map-glyphs && pnpm run version:stamp",
    "release": "pnpm nx release",
    "start": "pnpm nx serve app",
    "start:android": "pnpm nx run app:build:android && nx run app:sync:android && nx run app:run:android",
    "start:api-prod-proxy": "pnpm nx serve app --configuration=with-proxy --no-hmr",
    "start-boards:api-prod-proxy": "nx serve urboards --configuration=with-proxy",
    "start:api-prod-proxy:external": "pnpm nx serve app --configuration=with-proxy --host 0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts all",
    "start-boards": "pnpm nx serve urboards",
    "start:ios": "pnpm nx run app:build:ios && nx run app:sync:ios && nx run app:run:ios",
    "sync:android": "pnpm nx build app --prod --skip-nx-cache && ionic capacitor sync android --no-build",
    "sync:android:local": "pnpm nx build app --configuration=local-android --skip-nx-cache && cross-env URBO_ANDROID_SCHEME=http ionic capacitor sync android --no-build",
    "sync:ios": "pnpm nx build app --prod && ionic capacitor sync ios --no-build",
    "sync:packages": "node ../scripts/sync-packages.js",
    "test": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx run-many -t test",
    "test:adapter": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx test adapter",
    "test:app": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx test app",
    "test:core": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx test core",
    "test:feature-app-feedback": "pnpm run typecheck-tests &&  nx test feature-app-feedback",
===@sw-code deps===
128:    "@sw-code/urbo-ui": "workspace:*",

observation.command: cd /workspace/app && cat .npmrc 2>/dev/null; echo "===package.json==="; sed -n '1,60p' package.json; echo "===@sw-code deps==="; grep -n "@sw-code" package.json
